title: Odile and the Machine
author: A. M. Dunmore
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
